summary: Iter-90 — Razorpay MOCK-mode regression re-run. Re-executed /app/backend/tests/test_razorpay_mock_flows.py against preview backend → 12/12 PASS (was 11 pass + 1 skip in iter-89; this round the recharge test now passes too). All four Razorpay-fronted money paths verified end-to-end in mock mode: (1) Registration-fee — GET /api/payment/config returns is_mock=true + registration_paid=false; POST /payment/create-order → order_id starts with 'order_MOCK_'; POST /payment/verify with pay_MOCK_* / sig_MOCK_* flips registration_paid=true; repeat create-order 400s with 'already paid'. (2) Wallet top-up — /wallet/topup/config returns is_mock=true + presets + min/max; /topup/start → /topup/verify (mock sig) credits wallet by EXACTLY the requested amount; replaying the same razorpay_payment_id is idempotent (no double credit); below-min and above-max both 400. (3) Shop checkout online — empty-cart 400; with a published 517644 in-stock product, /orders/payment/start returns is_mock=true + mock order id + amount_paise=round(amount*100); /orders/payment/verify with pay_MOCK_* 200s; /orders/payment/pending surfaces the paid-unconsumed attempt. (4) Recharge — /recharge/payment/{start,verify} both 200 with pay_MOCK_* in mock mode. Frontend code review (unchanged since iter-89): wallet-topup.tsx:160-165, checkout.tsx:329-331, payment.tsx:238-239, recharge.tsx:138-140 all correctly branch on start.is_mock and synthesise pay_MOCK_/sig_MOCK_ before /verify — matches backend contract. NO issues found; the preview intentionally runs in mock mode because RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET are not configured, and the mock pipeline works end-to-end.
action_items: No code changes required. Preview is intentionally in mock mode. When the owner adds RAZORPAY_KEY_ID + RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET (via Admin → Payment Gateway OR backend/.env), is_mock flips to false and the client stops synthesising pay_MOCK_* — the same /verify endpoints then run real HMAC + api.razorpay.com cross-check paths (already implemented in core/razorpay.verify_signature + fetch_payment).
critical_code_review_comments: core/razorpay.get_creds precedence (db → env → mock) is correct; is_mock=true only when BOTH key sources are empty.

routes/order_payments.verify_online_payment and routes/wallet_topup.verify_topup both short-circuit HMAC + api.razorpay.com checks when creds.is_mock — this is what lets pay_MOCK_/sig_MOCK_ land in /verify successfully.
wallet_topup verify is idempotent via a `created|abandoned → paid` status claim; replaying the same razorpay_payment_id does NOT credit twice (confirmed via before/after balance diff).
/orders/payment/pending surfaces paid-but-unconsumed attempts so a double-tap on checkout cannot charge twice.
server.py:/payment/create-order dedups 'created' transactions per user, preventing wallet-history inflation.

success_rate.frontend: verified via code review (unchanged from iter-89)

All four money paths (registration, wallet top-up, shop checkout, recharge) complete cleanly end-to-end in mock mode with correct amount math, correct is_mock flag, correct idempotency, and correct guards (empty-cart, below-min, above-max, already-paid). The owner's 'payment is confusing' concern on preview is explained by the intentional mock mode.
